verdict.rationale: Netlify offers storage-adjacent products (Netlify Blobs, Netlify Database/Postgres) so a storage billing/auto-grow question is plausible, but the evidence pack contains no documentation or community evidence about disk/storage auto-scaling behavior or a pay-per-byte-written billing model — only unrelated feature lists and billing complaints about bandwidth/DDoS overages. Missing for 10: any docs on storage capacity provisioning, auto-grow mechanics, or per-byte-written pricing for Netlify Blobs/Database.
